applicant_utility.summary: This scholarship is single-degree by design: it exists only for international students admitted full-time to the Bachelor of Agricultural Science or its Honours year in the Faculty of Science, and the Dean of Science nominates the recipient rather than a central scholarships office. There is no form to submit - your admission application is the application - so the entire task is landing an unconditional offer in the right degree. The published close date of 01 December 2025 has passed with no successor announced, so applicants for a future start should plan around admission timing and check the page for the next date.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students offered a place in the Bachelor of Agricultural Science (or Honours) at Sydney who can hold a 65 semester average.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for admission to the Bachelor of Agricultural Science or its Honours year in the Faculty of Science - not any other Sydney degree

applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, travel and tuition - the $20,000 per annum is a cash scholarship, not a fee waiver

applicant_utility.summary: You never apply for this scholarship - you apply for the graduate research course, and if that application lands before the course's closing date you are automatically considered and receive confirmation within seven days. What decides the outcome is panel ranking on your previous academic results and research potential, so a strong transcript plus evidence of research output such as refereed publications, a same-level degree or relevant professional experience is the lever to pull. Domestic students receive the Research Training Program fee offset with their course offer, while stipend-and-fee-offset offers are issued separately but around the same time.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving research-degree applicants, domestic or international, who want full fee remission plus a living stipend without a separate scholarship deadline.

common_rejection_risks: Missing the graduate research course closing date - there is no late scholarship route

Treating the stipend as automatic: offers go to the highest-ranked applicants
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Costs beyond the stipend and fee offset - dependants' costs are not covered, and relocation support is a one-off allowance rather than ongoing travel cover
document_audit: No separate scholarship documents, but the course application must meet entry requirements at assessment time
